description: The same rivet head with the arc ending on the axis, plus a dome-cap variant with the circle centre 1.3e-4 off the axis. Put h = sqrt(25 - center^2) and a = pi/2 + atan(center/h). Integrating signed pi*x^2 dy along the arc gives volume pi*(25*center*a + 25*h - h^3/3). The axial moment is pi times the integral of (x - center)*x^2 from 0 to center+5. The surface of revolution integrates 2*pi*x along the arc and the disk contributes pi*(center+5)^2.

analytic.volume: pi * (25 * center * (pi / 2 + atan(center / sqrt(25 - center ^ 2))) + (50 + center ^ 2) * sqrt(25 - center ^ 2) / 3)
analytic.area: 10 * pi * (center * (pi / 2 + atan(center / sqrt(25 - center ^ 2))) + sqrt(25 - center ^ 2)) + pi * (center + 5) ^ 2
centroid: ((center + 5) ^ 4 / 4 - center * (center + 5) ^ 3 / 3) / (25 * center * (pi / 2 + atan(center / sqrt(25 - center ^ 2))) + (50 + center ^ 2) * sqrt(25 - center ^ 2) / 3)
